selector.only_skip_when: mode is exact string pure from successful trusted selector
selector.supported_preparation: two-parent merge with parents exactly original base SHA then original head SHA

derived_inputs.managed_applicable: complete git diff --no-renames --name-only -z <original_base_sha> <prepared_sha> --; immutable BASE applicability policy
derived_inputs.cold_caches: original GITHUB_EVENT_PATH pull_request.body exact first-line marker; body edit compares original changes.body.from both directions

producer.tuple_digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 of versioned canonical tuple
producer.marker_dependencies: successful trusted identity preparation only; never quality
full_required_source_contexts: macos-native / ARM macOS process and credentials
producer.observation_digest_encoding: lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 compact ensure_ascii JSON [2,tuple_digest,FULL_run_id,1]; no whitespace; FULL_run_id positive integer <=9007199254740991
producer.observation_pointer_authority: independently find latest FULL from complete interval, compute binding and compare; stdout pointer is not authority
producer.tuple_digest_encoding: lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 compact ensure_ascii JSON array in tuple_fields order; integers/booleans typed, no whitespace
producer.authority_digest_encoding: lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 compact ensure_ascii JSON sorted [[path,SHA256(BASE bytes)],...]; complete BASE workflow inventory plus selector authority_paths; same paths/bytes required in head/prepared

public_history.selection: latest matching FULL after only matching PURE observations in a complete bounded interval

check_consumer.owner: parent-owned external manual-tool integration; installed extension unchanged
ignore_later_pure_only_when: unique provider referenced_workflows unit path/ref/sha attests exact prepared source; unit/bootstrap/program/policy/workflow bytes match trusted immutable base
selector observation has exact current immutable tuple and trusted program authority
public attempt Jobs and Checks have none of the three required source context names, including skipped
selected run/attempt is the latest applicable FULL admitted by the complete interval
selected FULL original head/base/prepared/policy/workflow/cold tuple still matches current inputs
check_consumer.then: evaluate actual selected FULL run Jobs and all three Actions-owned Checks exactly as before
check_consumer.failed_pending_absent_cancelled_full: remain failed pending absent or cancelled; never replaced by pure success
check_consumer.newer_unknown_or_changed_input: block or require full; never latest-green search

original_vs_current_inputs.historic_tuple: provider-attested prepared merge parents/tree and original trusted program executed against immutable GITHUB_EVENT_PATH, never later mutable PR payload
original_vs_current_inputs.current_tuple: current PR head/base/repositories/ref plus attested prepared tree/parents/workflow and current body exact-marker flag; independently derive applicability using BASE policy
original_vs_current_inputs.body_transition_rule: trusted owner enforces original changes.body.from both directions; current body cannot reconstruct historical transitions or replace original event. Missing provenance/unknown intervening work->hold/FULL
original_vs_current_inputs.admission_pointer: derive first FULL, then verify SHA256([2,tuple_digest,FULL_run_id,1]) for each intervening and final PURE marker. Ignore stdout result claims

workflow_integration_gate.stable_writes: blocked until root hands sealed APT producer source
workflow_integration_gate.trusted_bootstrap: read/copy owner from immutable original base before running any candidate program; missing owner -> full
workflow_integration_gate.source_queue: edited basefalse and ready unique run/attempt group before prepare; ready always full
workflow_integration_gate.pure_names: dynamic aggregate plus renamed skipped source-security/native callers; emit none of the protected context names
workflow_integration_gate.default_failure_names: original source names and full/fail-closed coverage
workflow_integration_gate.publication: blocked until M3 owner integration and one code acceptance review
workflow_integration_gate.always_invoked_unit: ci-admission caller always invokes tiny source-attested identity+marker reusable unit even for PURE; no quality child invoked by PURE

provider_attestation.required_for: every historical FULL/PURE and every final PURE accepted by external consumer
provider_attestation.source_authority: read attested prepared commit and original base/head objects; compare unit/bootstrap/owner/contract/policy/all workflow bytes to immutable original base
provider_attestation.missing_mismatch_duplicate_unknown: FULL or hold; never trust marker self-declaration
provider_attestation.current_early_visibility: selector does not depend on referenced_workflows while current unit is starting; external must validate final run attestation

applicability_policy.authority: immutable original BASE bytes, identical in head/prepared
applicability_policy.pr_checks_sha256: must equal SHA256 of complete immutable BASE .github/scripts/pr-checks.mjs bytes
applicability_policy.complete_paths: full no-renames NUL Git diff original base→prepared, no caller/path truncation; decode/size error->FULL
applicability_policy.external_derivation: compute exact same complete Git paths and BASE policy; do not consume selector managed bool as authority
